reading: A repeat of (element, guard) is a cycle. The shipped attack stores DP records only and has no self-collision detector, so a cycle whose 20-odd elements contain no DP (probability 1 - 20*2^-80) never reports and the trail is PENDING at every cutoff. The increment is irrelevant to the trap; it only decides whether a solve WOULD have existed had both records been kept. Both classes are charged as traps in v19.
